name: DrawerPullCard
job: A card with a hidden drawer that slides out from beneath to show extra details such as hours, specs or inclusions
visitor_action: click or tap the drawer front (or press Enter); click again or Escape closes it
owner_settings: Drawer contents (rows of label and value)
mobile: drawer slides down below the card on tap
motion: drawer slides on eased rails with tiny bounce at stop (reduced-motion: drawer shown open)

checks.render: skipped (render gate disabled for this batch)
checks.craft: skipped (craft gate disabled for this batch)

art_direction: Minimal industrial design (Rams-like): matte warm-grey slab, edge-to-edge photo, one oversized grotesk title (Hanken 600, tight tracking); raised drawer front with a single orange round pull (#f0561d) that slides a charcoal (#232325) tray of large tabular values. Flat, no wood, no shadows.
